changelog.summary: Major pivot: Switched from Waveshare ESP32-C6 1.47" (now designated for AvaDrive) to DIYmalls ESP32-2432S024C 2.4" capacitive touch. Key advantage: built-in IP5603 battery management chip with JST 1.25mm connector — LiPo plugs directly in, no soldering. Switched from bundled stuffed animal to strap-on concept (kid uses their own stuffed animal). Set $99 retail price ($79-89 launch promo). Defined made-to-order business model to minimize upfront investment. Identified Amazon + AliExpress sourcing strategy. Ordering Tuesday.

App Store rejection (fixable): needs medical citations + BLE demo video + hardware ownership answers. Planned Phase 2 lifecycle upgrade path: same hardware converts from simulation toy to real CGM display via OTA firmware update (9-49 upgrade). Phase 3 vision: full AVA ecosystem — one hardware platform, multiple firmware profiles, lifetime customer relationship.
